options.text: Whether its properties fit the use, such as conducting heat poorly.
Whether it is a metal, because every metal handle stays cool.
Whether material properties matter for objects — they do not.

stem:
Anika needs a pan handle that will not get too hot.

What should she check in the material?

teacher.key_rationale: Choose a material whose properties fit the purpose. A cool handle needs poor heat conduction. Shine alone and 'every metal stays cool' are not the fit test.
